text: On the left side of the opponent’s penalty area, about 3.5 metres from goal at the far end, Luca Iversen wins the ball with a strong tackle high up the pitch. He sends a long pass across the field to Mason Morales on the left flank. Morales quickly delivers a precise cross to Iversen near the penalty spot, who controls and strikes with his foot, scoring to level the match at 3-3. This swift attack, completed in just over eight seconds and involving two passes, showcases Kingsmoor FC’s wide, crossing play style [#1512] [#1513] [#1514] [#1516].
